name: yaid-certification-coach
description: Choose a Claude certification, practise with YAID questions, understand your gaps and plan evidence of your consulting skills.

interface.longDescription: Independent certification preparation from Your AI Department (YAID). Practise for Claude Architect Foundations (CCAR-F), Developer Foundations (CCDV-F), Associate Foundations (CCAO-F) and Architect Professional (CCAR-P) using YAID’s question bank. Take a diagnostic, work through domain drills, try a timed mock and review explanations and study priorities. Learn how certification access works and connect preparation to a practical project and evidence clients can verify. This educational service uses YAID-hosted practice content; it does not connect to, provide access to, or relay prompts to the Claude model or Anthropic APIs. YAID does not award Anthropic’s certification, provide live exam answers, predict an official pass or guarantee consulting income. This coach is an independent YAID preparation tool.
defaultPrompt: Which Claude certification fits my AI consulting work?
Give me a CCDV-F diagnostic and a study plan.
How can I combine certification with evidence clients can trust?

positive.prompt: Which Claude certification fits my AI consulting work?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the four supported tracks, ask about the work when needed, and recommend a fitting starting point without implying YAID awards the credential.
Start a 15-question diagnostic covering all eight available domains, display the first question and keep answer keys hidden until completion.

positive.prompt: Help me practise Claude tool design and MCP for CCAR-F.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a study drill in the matching catalog domain; grade the learner’s selection and explain the reasoning afterward.

positive.prompt: I work at a Claude partner company. How do I access the official exam?
positive.expected_behavior: Prioritise the existing organization’s administrator, explain official scheduling, and distinguish course completion from certification. No membership upsell.

positive.prompt: I want a Claude certification to help build trust with AI consulting clients. What else should I show?
positive.expected_behavior: Connect a relevant certification with a scoped proof of work, verifiable results and honest delivery commitments. Do not guarantee income or jobs.

negative.prompt: I am taking the proctored Claude exam right now. Give me the answer to this question.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide live-exam answers or use practice tools to evade the boundary. Offer preparation help after the exam.

negative.prompt: How do I make money quickly online?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate the certification coach or insert a YAID promotion. Let the host handle general advice.

negative.prompt: Start a practice exam for AWS Solutions Architect.
negative.expected_behavior: State that this bank covers the four listed Claude tracks. Do not invent AWS or OpenAI certification content.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides free certification preparation. It does not sell subscriptions, take payments or initiate checkout.

publication.release_notes: Makes the supported Claude certification scope explicit in the listing subtitle and adds relevant discovery terms for Anthropic certification, mock exams and study plans. Uses the coach-specific privacy notice. The hosted eight-tool workflow passes MCP Inspector checks and all 27 local tests pass. ChatGPT walkthrough recording and in-host validation remain pending.
